decisions.reason: The compact dumper builds on the established offer and kept its own page in both years, so its results appear to meet aspirations and there is no reason for problemistic search.
The articulated dumper fits the core construction range and its presence on the website stayed stable, so management has little reason to give it up.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core and fell from its own page to a mere mention, which suggests a shortfall, but it serves a niche that fits the firm's underground expertise, and slack in this mid-market firm may let it carry the product for another year.
The telescopic loader line has several models, builds on the established offer and was consistently presented, which indicates sunk commitment and satisfactory performance.

The material lift line is close to the core offer and was only launched in 2024, so its results are still uncertain, and the firm is likely to give it time rather than drop it after so short a period.
The underground loader is distant from the core but new and prominently presented, so management will likely keep it while evaluating it against aspirations.
